reviews.x: Overall I was pleased. I received all 20, and only 1 was missing the gem stone, can't really complain because of the price though. They arrived a week earlier than expected. Got a nice variety of colors and 2 or 3 of them were duplicates. The gauge is a bit smaller than 16g, possibly 18g. In the pic the one on the right is a 16g and the one on the left is what I received. Good deal for the price.
they were smaller gauged then expected most  have stones were missing out of them.

I only got 19 in my package, but customer service was excellent and quick to respond, and at that price I could hardly complain anyway. It's a good mix of colors with some repeats, and the stones have decent sparkle to them. The quality of mine were fine, no loose stones or sharp edges. I think that they are 18g but I'm not 100% on that. They fit well and stay put, even during sleep and showers. Overall I'm happy with my purchase.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: I guess I should have read the reviews a little more before purchasing this if I could give it less than one star I would. Half the rhinestones were missing and they are very thin and small like fish hooks

The selection is good, with many colors to choose from. There were a few repeats of certain colors, but that was not a problem for me. My only complaint is that they don't sit right on my nose, which may just be the way my nose in particular is shaped. I haven't had them for very long, so I cannot yet comment on how well they do or do not hold up. The metal is not silver, but more a dark silver, almost gunmetal but not quite that dark. This really isn't noticeable when the studs are in your nose
The gems are really small, and the pack I received were smaller than 18g. If you're looking for something less noticeable like for work, but still a little sparkle, these are okay for that.
I love them they fit and r more secure then any other I've used!

I was excited for these to come in. Although the screw is hard to get in, I totally changed it to make it L shaped. My complaint is that the rhinestones come off easily. Some were already off when I opened the package, some came off during wearing, and other fell off as I was putting it in. I would just spend the money to get something better. I've had them about 3 days and 7 rhinestones are already gone.

reviews.t: I only got 18 and 2 of the 18 gems ...
reviews.x: I only got 18 and 2 of the 18 gems where missing. But I contact customer service and they explain everything very helpful. They came 3 week to my home. Overall they where really cute I will say they're 18g but fit in a 16g needle they're small but still cute.
Great nose studs. These are my second time ordering them. The other ones I got a few years ago and they have all been lost or jewels have fallen out. They last a good amount of time for the price.
Some of these were broke when I received them.  The stones fall out easily on some, not on others.  For the price, good product.  I've had one in for about 3 months with no problems.
Got these in a week I believe.. cant even lie, these things are the real deal. So many colors to pick from everyday. Was skeptical at the checkout but I'm glad I got them tbh 🤙🏽

reviews.t: Not really crazy about it. Its mostly a handful ...
reviews.x: Not really crazy about it. Its mostly a handful of pinks and blues. Unlike the picture, I didn't get any black or yellow. I bought this mostly for the black/grey ones.
they're impossible to get in your nose until you cut the end off with wire cutters, but then they come out even easier than a regular nose stud
These were to small for my nose. Probably about a 20G size and i'm an 18
Omg this are so comfortable my friends actually took most of them...

reviews.t: Not as advertised - and cannot return.
reviews.x: Much, much smaller than I expected. I thought they were 20 pieces, all 20 guage. All of them are much smaller than that and many of the stones are crooked, like they're too big for the setting in the post.  I have one already that is for sure a 20 gauge. In the picture I submitted, it's the crystal one on the right. One of the 20 I received from this pack, on the left, is blue.  And I cannot return them. So now I'm stuck with nose studs that will just fall through my piercing. I'm very disappoin

Great for the price! I have sensitive skin and they still haven't bothered me at all. They are quite a bit smaller than the 16g  that I got pierced with, and I wish I knew what gage they are, but I wanted something smaller so I'm happy. Paid like $1.50 or something like that for 20 so I'm pleased with these cute little studs. If I lose them or stones fall out, they're cheap enough that I can easily get more.

reviews.t: Price is right and they're super cute. Smaller than I thought they would be ...
reviews.x: Arrived faster than expected. Price is right and they're super cute. Smaller than I thought they would be gauge wise. And, I don't know if it's just me, or if there have been others, but I had a heck of a time getting these in my nose. So much so that I wouldn't buy them again for that reason. But, for the price, you're getting some fun colors and a good variety.

I got all 20 only one gem fell out but they're really long. I've worn these before and the L shaped part is supposed to be laying on the inside of my nose and it doesn't do that, it sticks out. It feels weird but I guess you get what you pay for. The price is now $6 and I only paid about $3 a few weeks ago. And I think $3 was enough for this quality

I only got 19 and 1 was missing a jewel and I got a a couple doubles but they are mostly of pretty colors so its fine and I put clear nail polish over the other jewels so they wouldn't fall out so far so good shipping was early but it still doesn't say they delivered even tho they have but that doesn't matter. Good for the price so 4 stars.

reviews.t: maybe a 22 at best. It just went through my nose completely
reviews.x: Was NOT 18g, maybe a 22 at best. It just went through my nose completely. Emailed for a refund and was told to MEASURE MY 18g ring next to theirs because there was no way their rings were the wrong size. Would NOT buy again.  The left is a 16, middle is an 18, the right which is their product is MAYBE a 22. Obviously not an 18g

These little nose rings are so cute and the variety of colors is really nice, though be prepared to find four or five of one color and then only one of another, but I still think it is well worth the price. Might want to invest in a little container or something for them though!

They were differing in lengths and I could only get a few in without my nose bleeding like crazy. The ones that actually fit stuck up off my nose and had to be pushed down and it didn’t take long for the stones to fall off. I guess you get what you pay for.

I ordered these hoping they'd be better than the last ones I ordered from a different seller. These are just like the ones I ordered when I first pierced my nose. The ones I bought after that first time were nowhere near as good as the first ones and these.

claims.text: Many reviewers report missing rhinestones or stones falling off, both on arrival and during wear.
Several reviewers say the gauge is smaller than expected, often around 18g or even 20g rather than 16g.
Reviewers frequently praise the good value and low price for the quantity received.
Many reviewers appreciate the wide variety of colors, though some note duplicate colors or missing expected shades.
Some reviewers mention receiving fewer pieces than the advertised count, while noting customer service was helpful.
